# Official documentation verification

Use primary sources from `docs.github.com`, `code.visualstudio.com`, `github.com/github`, or `learn.microsoft.com`.

For each product claim:

1. Capture the canonical URL.
2. Record the date checked.
3. Identify whether the capability is stable, preview, experimental, or availability-dependent.
4. Avoid generalizing support from one harness to another.
5. Prefer product documentation over blog posts and release announcements.
